name: Practical Course Enterprise Software
description: In this 12 week hands on practical, students learn to take an idea from zero to one, from the first product sketch to a fully functional, cloud hosted release. The focus is on data driven web and engineering projects that make productive use of modern AI tools and machine learning techniques (e.g. generative language models, vector search, ML Ops pipelines). Working in agile, cross functional teams of about 12–15 developers and guided by experienced industry mentors, participants tackle real world problems in an industry like environment. The course emphasizes modern software engineering practices, continuous integration/delivery, and product discovery. At the end of the term the teams present their results in a live demo that includes deployment, monitoring, and meaningful metrics.
prerequisites:
- Basic understanding of JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and both relational (SQL) and document based (NoSQL) databases
- Practical experience with at least one functional or object oriented programming language (e.g. Python, Java, C++, Haskell …)
- Familiarity with a modern frontend stack, e.g. TypeScript or Svelte (including frameworks such as React, Next.js, SvelteKit)
- Familiarity with a modern backend stack (one or more of): TypeScript (Node.js, Express, Fastify, NestJS), Python (FastAPI, Django, Flask), Rust (Actix web, Axum) or Go (Gin, Fiber), Knowledge of API design (REST / GraphQL) and cloud native concepts is advantageous

*Helpful:  Experience with visualization, data processing (D3, Plotly, Pandas) and ML frameworks (scikit learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow) 

For detailed participation criteria, please refer to the course page under “Teilnahmekriterien und Anmeldung”.
